translations.idiomatic: E had men carry grass over the thin ice and set it ablaze; government troops then pressed Leitai harder; Shu forces recovered Tongzi; Longxi, cornered, burned his camp and fled by night.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，龍喜餘黨鄒長保再叛，圍桐梓七晝夜，並據婁山關以遏遵援。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year Longxi's remnant party Zou Changbao rebelled again, besieged Tongzi seven days and nights, and also held Loushan Pass to block Zunyi relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth winter Longxi's remnant Zou Changbao rebelled again, besieged Tongzi seven days and nights, and held Loushan Pass against relief from Zunyi.

sentences.zh: 諤复集兵練千餘名，攻奪婁山，解其圍。

translations.literal: E again gathered more than a thousand militia, attacked and seized Loushan, and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: E gathered more than a thousand militia, retook Loushan, and broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 期必滅賊，屢深入至寺岡。

translations.literal: Determined to destroy the rebels, he repeatedly went deep as far as Sigang.
translations.idiomatic: Resolved to destroy the rebels, he pushed repeatedly into Sigang.

sentences.zh: 寺岡，賊巢所在，危峰攢刺，往往雲霧，不見天日。

translations.literal: Sigang, where the rebel nest lay, had perilous peaks clustered like spikes; often cloud and mist—one could not see the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Sigang, the rebels' lair, was a tangle of perilous peaks, often lost in cloud so that daylight never showed.

sentences.zh: 諤勒兵直上，以身先之，猝遇伏，前鋒為所敗，諤親率卒二十人搏戰。

translations.literal: E drove the troops straight up, taking the lead himself; suddenly meeting an ambush the vanguard was beaten; E personally led twenty soldiers in desperate fight.
translations.idiomatic: He drove his men straight up, leading from the front; an ambush shattered the vanguard; he himself led twenty men in a last stand.

sentences.zh: 賊眾麕至，矢石交下，諤力竭死之。

translations.literal: Rebel masses crowded in; arrows and stones rained down; E, strength spent, died.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels swarmed in; arrows and stones poured down; E, spent, was killed.

sentences.zh: 隨行之王世洪、曾名標亦奮鬥死，時咸豐四年十一月十日也。

translations.literal: Wang Shihong and Zeng Mingbiao who followed also fought fiercely and died—it was the tenth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shihong and Zeng Mingbiao, who were with him, also fought to the death on the tenth day of the eleventh month of Xianfeng 4.

sentences.zh: 卹道銜，給世職，立專祠。

translations.literal: Posthumous daoyuan rank, hereditary office, and a dedicated shrine were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted posthumous daoyuan rank, a hereditary office, and a dedicated shrine.

sentences.zh: 趙國澍，貴州貴陽人。

translations.literal: Zhao Guoshu, a native of Guiyang in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guoshu was from Guiyang, Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，黔中土匪起，國澍方為諸生，居青岩。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng local bandits rose in Qianzhong; Guoshu was then a licentiate, living at Qingyan.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 bandits rose in Qian; Guoshu was a licentiate living at Qingyan.

sentences.zh: 其地扼定番、廣順之衝，為貴陽屏蔽。

translations.literal: That place choked the crossing of Dingfan and Guangshun and was Guiyang's screen.
translations.idiomatic: The place commanded the crossing toward Dingfan and Guangshun and screened Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 乃散家財，倡團練，城青岩自守，隨官軍四出勦賊。

translations.literal: He then dispersed family wealth, took the lead in militia drill, walled Qingyan for self-defense, and followed government troops in four directions to hunt rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He spent his family's wealth, raised militia, fortified Qingyan, and marched with government troops against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 十年，粵酋石達開竄貴州，陷廣順，圍定番，眾號二十萬，貴州大震。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Cantonese chief Shi Dakai slipped into Guizhou, took Guangshun, besieged Dingfan—the host was said to be two hundred thousand—and Guizhou shook greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Taiping leader Shi Dakai entered Guizhou, took Guangshun, and besieged Dingfan with a host said to number two hundred thousand; the province was shaken.

sentences.zh: 國澍倡勇敢、救定番，民壯從者數百人。

translations.literal: Guoshu urged courage to save Dingfan; stalwart civilians followed in several hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Guoshu called for a rescue of Dingfan; several hundred stout men followed him.

sentences.zh: 力戰城下竟日，賊斷其歸路，死亡略盡。

translations.literal: They fought fiercely below the wall all day; rebels cut their return route; deaths were nearly total.
translations.idiomatic: They fought below the walls all day until the rebels cut off retreat; nearly all were killed.

sentences.zh: 國澍匹馬突圍還青岩，登陴堅守，賊亦卻退。

translations.literal: Guoshu on a single horse broke the encirclement back to Qingyan, climbed the wall and held firm, and rebels also drew back.
translations.idiomatic: Guoshu broke out alone on horseback, returned to Qingyan, manned the walls, and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 會賊以廣順之眾益定番之圍，道出青岩，脅降，不可。

translations.literal: It happened rebels with Guangshun's host increased the siege of Dingfan, passed by Qingyan, and coerced surrender—he would not.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels reinforcing the siege of Dingfan passed Qingyan they demanded surrender; he refused.

sentences.zh: 圍三日，引去。

translations.literal: After three days of siege they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After three days they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 七月，定番陷，並力攻青岩，國澍隨機應禦，賊攻六月，終不能下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Dingfan fell; they combined strength to attack Qingyan; Guoshu met each move in defense; rebels attacked six months and in the end could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Dingfan fell; the rebels turned on Qingyan; Guoshu parried each assault for six months until they could not take the town.

sentences.zh: 伺賊稍懈，乞援提督田興恕，興恕遣侄麒麟來，大為民擾，國澍斬麒麟以徇。

translations.literal: Watching rebels slacken slightly, he begged aid from General Tian Xingnu; Xingnu sent his nephew Qilin, who greatly harassed the people; Guoshu beheaded Qilin to warn the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels slackened he asked General Tian Xingnu for help; Xingnu sent his nephew Qilin, who preyed on the people; Guoshu executed Qilin as an example.

sentences.zh: 興恕親赴之，前鋒失利，責戰益急。

translations.literal: Xingnu came in person; the vanguard lost; he blamed them and pressed battle harder.
translations.idiomatic: Xingnu came himself; when the vanguard failed he blamed them and drove them harder.

sentences.zh: 國澍策賊食將盡，請斂軍堅壘障省城，檄清鎮、安平、大定清野以待。

translations.literal: Guoshu judged rebel food was nearly gone and asked to draw in the army, hold stout ramparts to shield the provincial city, and order Qingzhen, Anping, and Dading to clear the countryside and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Guoshu judged the rebels' food nearly gone and proposed pulling back behind strong walls to shield the capital while Qingzhen, Anping, and Dading cleared the countryside.

sentences.zh: 貸土匪陳文禮等死，密遣入賊縱火，內外夾擊，毀賊營二，賊每夜自驚。

translations.literal: He lent death to local bandit Chen Wenli and others, secretly sent men into the rebel camp to set fire, struck within and without, destroyed two rebel camps, and rebels startled themselves each night.
translations.idiomatic: He spared the bandit Chen Wenli and others, sent men secretly into the rebel camp to burn it, struck from inside and out, destroyed two camps, and the rebels panicked nightly.

sentences.zh: 國澍以計間其悍酋，使相屠，遂大閧，因與興恕合兵乘之，賊崩潰。

translations.literal: Guoshu by stratagem sowed discord among their fierce chiefs so they slaughtered one another; a great uproar ensued; he then joined Xingnu's combined troops to press them and the rebels collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Guoshu set their fierce chiefs against one another until they turned on each other; then he and Xingnu struck together and the rebels collapsed.

sentences.zh: 追奔至安平，復大破之，定、廣諸城皆复。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rout to Anping he broke them again greatly; Ding, Guang, and all cities were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued to Anping and broke them again; Dingfan, Guangshun, and the other towns were recovered.

sentences.zh: 先是國澍​​剿平定、廣土匪葛老岩、楊龍喜及平伐、擺金、平越、甕安諸賊，收復修文等城，累擢至候選同知、直隸州知州，賞花翎。

translations.literal: Earlier Guoshu had suppressed local bandits of Ding and Guang—Ge Laoyan, Yang Longxi—and bandits of Pingfa, Baijin, Pingyue, Weng'an, and others, recovering Xiufen and other cities; he was repeatedly promoted to candidate subprefect and direct-administration department magistrate and rewarded with the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Guoshu had crushed bandits around Dingfan and Guangshun—Ge Laoyan, Yang Longxi—and rebels at Pingfa, Baijin, Pingyue, Weng'an, recovering Xiufen and other towns, rising to candidate subprefect and department magistrate with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 至是興恕上其功，言：「國澍毀家、築城、練團、當巨寇，受攻半載，卒創賊，全省會，非優獎不足以勸士民。」

translations.literal: At this Xingnu reported his merit, saying: "Guoshu ruined his house, built walls, drilled militia, faced a great bandit, was attacked half a year, and at last broke the rebels and saved the whole province—without outstanding reward one cannot encourage scholars and commoners."
translations.idiomatic: Xingnu then memorialized: "Guoshu ruined his house, built walls, drilled militia, held off a great rebel host for half a year, and broke them—only exceptional reward can encourage the province."

sentences.zh: 命以道員即選，並總辦貴州團練事務。

translations.literal: He was ordered immediate selection as daoyuan and made overall director of Guizhou militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was named daoyuan for immediate appointment and put in charge of Guizhou militia.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月，安順仲苗匪警，國澍率黔勇七百，會總兵羅孝連剿之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eleventh year an alarm of Zhong Miao bandits arose at Anshun; Guoshu led seven hundred Qian braves and joined General Luo Xiaolian to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eleventh year Zhong Miao bandits alarmed Anshun; Guoshu led seven hundred Guizhou braves with General Luo Xiaolian to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 十月，至安順，仲苗蔓延鎮、永二州，負險累年。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he reached Anshun; Zhong Miao spread through Zhen and Yong prefectures, holding terrain for years.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he reached Anshun; Zhong Miao had spread through Zhenxiong and Yongning, entrenched for years.

sentences.zh: 其老巢曰養馬塞、烏束隴、蜜蜂屯、猛董山，孝連直搗烏束隴，國澍調團練分塞要隘，斷賊援。

translations.literal: Their old nests were called Yangmasai, Wushulong, Mifengtun, and Mengdong Hill; Xiaolian drove straight at Wushulong while Guoshu deployed militia to block passes and cut rebel aid.
translations.idiomatic: Their nests were Yangmasai, Wushulong, Mifengtun, and Mengdong Hill; Xiaolian struck Wushulong while Guoshu blocked passes and cut rebel reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 養馬塞賊懼，縛酋獻地降，國澍乘勝攻蜜蜂屯。

translations.literal: Yangmasai rebels feared, bound their chief and offered land in surrender; Guoshu pressed the victory to attack Mifengtun.
translations.idiomatic: At Yangmasai the rebels, afraid, bound their chief and surrendered land; Guoshu pressed on to Mifengtun.

sentences.zh: 十一月，破水西莊阿打洞屯，賊詐乞撫，國澍佯納之，使兵冒賊衣裝，夜入蜜蜂屯，遂克其巢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he broke the Shuixi Zhuang Ada Cave stockade; rebels falsely begged pacification; Guoshu pretended to accept, had troops wear rebel dress, entered Mifengtun by night, and took the nest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he took the Ada Cave stockade; rebels feigned surrender; Guoshu pretended to accept, sent men in rebel dress into Mifengtun by night, and seized the nest.

sentences.zh: 群賊蟻居猛董，復會諸軍圍而殲之。

translations.literal: The rebel host swarmed at Mengdong; he again joined all armies to surround and annihilate them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels massed at Mengdong; allied troops surrounded and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 同治元年正月，石頭寨等隘以次蕩平，安順肅清，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi passes such as Shitouzhai were pacified in turn; Anshun was cleared; he was given vice censor-in-chief rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tongzhi 1 passes including Shitouzhai fell in turn; Anshun was cleared; he received vice censor rank.

sentences.zh: 會楊岩保兵潰，上大坪苗夷槓匪踵敗兵渡清水江，國澍聞警馳赴郎岱，擊苗匪破之。

translations.literal: When Yang Yanbao's troops collapsed, Shangping Miao and Yi gang bandits followed the beaten army across the Qingshui River; Guoshu heard the alarm and rushed to Langdai, struck Miao bandits and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Yanbao's force collapsed, Miao and Yi bandits followed the rout across the Qingshui; Guoshu hurried to Langdai and broke the Miao.

sentences.zh: 連戰皆捷，進剿水城。

translations.literal: Battle after battle was won; he advanced to suppress Shuicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Victory followed victory; he advanced against Shuicheng.

sentences.zh: 賊散踞洞塞，地皆險奧，國澍分兵雕剿，自夏經冬，破洞塞百餘。

translations.literal: Rebels scattered to hold cave stockades in terrain all perilous and deep; Guoshu divided troops to hunt them down; from summer through winter more than a hundred cave stockades were broken.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held cave strongholds in rugged country; Guoshu divided his men to root them out; from summer through winter he broke more than a hundred caves.

sentences.zh: 賊走渡江，遂沿江設守，乃還省，請增兵協餉，以備深入苗疆。

translations.literal: Rebels fled across the river; he then set guards along the river and returned to the capital, asking to add troops and coordinate funds to prepare for deep entry into the Miao country.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled across the river; he posted guards along the bank, returned to the capital, and asked for more troops and funds to penetrate the Miao hills.

sentences.zh: 而御史華祝三、湖南巡撫毛鴻賓劾田興恕苛斂，並及國澍殘刻狀。

translations.literal: But Censor Hua Zhusan and Hunan Governor Mao Hongbin impeached Tian Xingnu for harsh levies and also reported Guoshu's cruel conduct.
translations.idiomatic: But Censor Hua Zhusan and Hunan Governor Mao Hongbin impeached Tian Xingnu for harsh levies and cited Guoshu's cruelty as well.

sentences.zh: 貴撫韓超為覆奏，辨甚晰，事乃寢。

translations.literal: Guizhou Governor Han Chao memorialized in reply with very clear argument, and the affair was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Governor Han Chao rebutted the charges clearly, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 會開州知州戴鹿芝​​殺天主教士，法使愬於朝，复連國澍。

translations.literal: It happened Kai Prefecture Magistrate Dai Luzhi killed a Catholic priest; the French minister complained at court and again implicated Guoshu.
translations.idiomatic: Then Kai Prefecture Magistrate Dai Luzhi killed a Catholic priest; the French minister complained at court and implicated Guoshu again.

sentences.zh: 蓋興恕嘗欲逐教民，而國澍左右遂背國澍有毀教堂、殺教民事。

translations.literal: For Xingnu had wished to expel converts, and men at Guoshu's side then behind Guoshu's back had destroyed churches and killed converts.
translations.idiomatic: Xingnu had wanted to drive out converts, and men around Guoshu had destroyed churches and killed Catholics without his knowledge.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督勞崇光與法使議，令國澍償金厚葬，事已平矣；

translations.literal: Guangdong-Guangxi Governor Lao Chongguang negotiated with the French minister, ordering Guoshu to pay gold for a lavish burial—the affair was already settled;
translations.idiomatic: Governor Lao Chongguang of Guangdong and Guangxi settled with the French minister, ordering Guoshu to pay for a grand burial—the matter seemed closed;

sentences.zh: 開州案起，並發前事，法使愬不已，朝廷命將軍崇實等視其獄。

translations.literal: the Kai Prefecture case arose and earlier matters were revived together; the French minister complained without cease; the court ordered General Chongshi and others to investigate the case.
translations.idiomatic: then the Kai Prefecture case revived the old charges; the French minister pressed on; the court sent General Chongshi and others to investigate.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，褫國澍職，遂撤團練局，苗事益急。

translations.literal: In the second year, third month, Guoshu's office was stripped; the militia bureau was then abolished, and Miao affairs grew more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, third month, Guoshu was dismissed and the militia bureau abolished; Miao troubles worsened.

sentences.zh: 四月，大吏檄國澍督練勇渡泡江河。

translations.literal: In the fourth month high officials ordered Guoshu to direct drilled braves across the Pao River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month superiors ordered Guoshu to lead drilled braves across the Pao River.

sentences.zh: 時沿江諸軍飢潰，賊再內犯，竄光沙，勢張甚。

translations.literal: At that time armies along the river were starving and collapsing; rebels again invaded inward, slipping into Guangsha, their power very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Armies along the river were starving and breaking; rebels invaded again toward Guangsha in great force.

sentences.zh: 國澍兼程進，次百宜，賊眾兵寡，遂被圍。

translations.literal: Guoshu pressed on by forced marches, halted at Baiyi; rebels were many, troops few, and he was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Guoshu marched hard to Baiyi; outnumbered, he was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 食盡援絕，力戰，死傷過半。

translations.literal: Food was gone and aid cut off; he fought with strength; dead and wounded were more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Food and reinforcements failed; he fought on; more than half his men were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 親軍數十人，擁國澍潰圍出走，至徐家堰，賊大至，奮鬥死之。

translations.literal: Several dozen personal guards surrounded Guoshu and broke the encirclement to flee; reaching Xujiayan rebels came in force; he fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: A few dozen guards broke out with him; at Xujiayan the rebels overtook them; he fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張亮基以聞，贈太常寺卿，賞騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Liangji reported it; he was posthumously made Minister of Rites and granted hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Liangji reported his death; the court made him Minister of Rites posthumously and granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant office.

sentences.zh: 子四，次以炯，光緒十二年進士第一，翰林院修撰。

translations.literal: He had four sons; the second, Yijiong, was first in the palace examination in the twelfth year of Guangxu and became Hanlin Academician Expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He had four sons; the second, Yijiong, topped the palace examination in Guangxu 12 and became a Hanlin expositor.

sentences.zh: 宋華嵩，四川工卩州人。

translations.literal: Song Huasong, a native of Gongzhou in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Huasong was from Gongzhou, Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年，滇匪竄四川，華嵩自備軍糈，以武監生倡辦團練，保衛鄉里。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng Yunnan bandits slipped into Sichuan; Huasong supplied his own army grain, and as a military student with supervision status took the lead in organizing militia to guard the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 9 Yunnan bandits entered Sichuan; Huasong supplied his own provisions and, as a military student, raised militia to defend his district.

sentences.zh: 十年，川匪藍大順圍州城，華嵩率團勇大破於五道碑，圍解。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Sichuan bandit Lan Dashun besieged the prefectural city; Huasong led militia braves to break them greatly at Wudaobei and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Sichuan rebel Lan Dashun besieged the city; Huasong's militia routed them at Wudaobei and lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 嗣防堵夾門關、青草坡、大進埠等處，凡自賊營逃出難民，資遣無算。

translations.literal: Thereafter he blocked Jiamen Pass, Qingcao Slope, Dajinbu, and other places; all refugees who escaped from rebel camps he aided and sent on without count.
translations.idiomatic: He then held Jiamen Pass, Qingcao Slope, Dajinbu, and other points, aiding countless refugees who fled the rebel camps.

sentences.zh: 藍逆撲蒲江，華嵩督團迎擊，屢勝之，賊竄去。

translations.literal: When the Lan rebels struck Pujiang, Huasong directed militia to meet and strike them, repeatedly winning, and the rebels slipped away.
translations.idiomatic: When Lan's band struck Pujiang, Huasong's militia met them repeatedly and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 十一年，藍逆由新津回竄，華嵩御之文華山南河岸，賊不得還，折入眉州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Lan rebels returned from Xinjin; Huasong held them on the south bank below Wenhua Hill so they could not return and they turned into Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Lan's men came back from Xinjin; Huasong held the south bank below Wenhua Hill and forced them toward Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 既而藍逆別股复竄蒲江，踞青水溪，華嵩率團進剿，多斬獲。

translations.literal: Before long another Lan band again slipped into Pujiang, held Qingshui Stream; Huasong led militia to pursue and cut down many.
translations.idiomatic: Soon another Lan band seized Qingshui Stream in Pujiang; Huasong pursued and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 卒因眾寡不敵，歿於陣。

translations.literal: In the end because numbers were unequal he perished in battle.
translations.idiomatic: At last, outnumbered, he fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 華嵩團練數年，捐銀米數甚鉅，輕財好義，能得人心，故所部練勇如王德明、王富舉、王富義、楊鎮川等，咸效死不顧。

translations.literal: Huasong drilled militia for years, donating silver and grain in great sums; light with wealth, loving righteousness, he could win men's hearts—therefore his drilled braves such as Wang Deming, Wang Fuji, Wang Fuyi, and Yang Zhenchuan all served unto death without regard.
translations.idiomatic: For years he drilled militia at enormous private cost; generous and righteous, he won men's hearts—so braves such as Wang Deming, Wang Fuji, Wang Fuyi, and Yang Zhenchuan followed him to the death.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，總督駱秉章上華嵩死狀，卹如例，於本籍建專祠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Governor Luo Bingzhang reported Huasong's death; condolence followed precedent, and a dedicated shrine was built in his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 Governor Luo Bingzhang reported his death; the court mourned him by precedent and built a shrine in his home district.

sentences.zh: 伯錫爾，哈密回王也，其受封始祖曰額貝都拉，畏兀兒種人。

translations.literal: Boxidar was the Hui king of Hami; his ennobled founding ancestor was called Ebeidula, a man of the Uyghur people.
translations.idiomatic: Boxidar was king of the Hami Hui; his ennobled ancestor Ebeidula was of Uyghur stock.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，獻玉門、瓜州地，立為一等扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign he presented the lands of Yumen and Guazhou and was established as a first-rank zasak.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi he offered the lands of Yumen and Guazhou and was made a first-rank zasak.

sentences.zh: 再傳曰額敏，晉封貝子。

translations.literal: At the second generation came Emin, advanced to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: The second generation, Emin, was raised to beizi.

sentences.zh: 傳玉素卜，晉封貝勒，加郡王銜。

translations.literal: It passed to Yusupu, advanced to beile with the rank of junwang.
translations.idiomatic: It passed to Yusupu, raised to beile with junwang rank.

sentences.zh: 三傳至伯錫爾​​，於道光十二年進封郡王。

translations.literal: At the third generation Boxidar in the twelfth year of Daoguang was advanced to junwang.
translations.idiomatic: At the third generation Boxidar was made junwang in Daoguang 12.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，以助開渠功，加親王銜，署理哈密幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, for merit in opening canals, he was given qinwang rank and acted as Hami assistant minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3, for helping open canals, he received qinwang rank and acted as Hami's assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 會南、北路各城叛回煽變，八月二十九日，哈密漢裝回匪馬兆強、馬環等焚掠附城村莊，伯錫爾及辦事大臣文祺率回丁出戰，斬兆強、環，餘黨潰，敘功賞用黃韁。

translations.literal: When southern and northern route cities rebelled and Hui stirred trouble, on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month Hami Han-dressed Hui bandits Ma Zhaoqiang, Ma Huan, and others burned and plundered villages near the city; Boxidar and Minister Wen Qi led Hui youths to battle, beheaded Zhaoqiang and Huan, the rest scattered, and for merit he was rewarded with use of yellow reins.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels stirred along the northern and southern routes, on the twenty-ninth of the eighth month Han-dressed Hui bandits Ma Zhaoqiang and Ma Huan looted villages near Hami; Boxidar and Wen Qi led Hui troops out, killed Zhaoqiang and Huan, and for the victory he was granted yellow reins.

sentences.zh: 九月初二日，圖古里克回匪馬添才戕稅局吏役及漢民七十餘家，南攻沁城，伯錫爾令章京巴海、守備趙英傑追捕，至北山板房溝，斬添才。

translations.literal: On the second day of the ninth month Tugurik Hui bandit Ma Tiancai killed tax-bureau clerks and runners and more than seventy Han households, then attacked south toward Qincheng; Boxidar ordered Clerk Bahai and Garrison Commander Zhao Yingjie to pursue; at Beishan Banfanggou Tiancai was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On the second of the ninth month the Tugurik Hui Ma Tiancai killed tax clerks and over seventy Han families, then marched on Qincheng; Boxidar sent Bahai and Zhao Yingjie after him and had him beheaded at Beishan Banfanggou.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，患隴右道梗，奏稱由肅州東歷蒙古漠南地，至山西歸化城，往還可百日，請由此轉餉。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, because the Longyou route was blocked, he memorialized that from Suzhou east through Inner Mongolia's southern desert to Guihua City in Shanxi the round trip could be a hundred days, and asked to turn supplies by this route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, with the Longyou route blocked, he proposed carrying grain east from Suzhou through Inner Mongolia to Guihua in Shanxi, a round trip of a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 然台站舊在漠北蒙古，力疲不能增設，時哈密協標兵僅五百餘人，安西協援兵二百人，不足分守。

translations.literal: But the old courier stations lay in Outer Mongolia north of the desert; worn out, they could not add more; at the time Hami coordinated-standard troops were only five hundred-odd, Anxi coordinated aid only two hundred—insufficient to divide for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Old stations lay in Outer Mongolia and could not be expanded; Hami had only five hundred coordinated troops and Anxi two hundred more—too few to garrison everywhere.

sentences.zh: 纏回及漢民雖眾，未習戰陣，吐魯番叛回頻來誘，人情煽動。

translations.literal: Chantefu and Han commoners were many but untrained in battle; Turfan rebels came often to entice them, and popular feeling was stirred.
translations.idiomatic: Chantefu and Han villagers were numerous but untrained; Turfan rebels kept enticing them, and feeling ran high.

sentences.zh: 五月，回匪黑老哇、纏匪蘇布格等反，辦事大臣札克當阿中彈死，賊毀漢城，入回城，幽伯錫爾。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Hui bandit Hei Laowa and Chantefu Subuge and others rebelled; Minister Zhakedang'a was struck by a bullet and died; rebels destroyed the Han city, entered the Hui city, and imprisoned Boxidar.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Hui Hei Laowa and the Chantefu Subuge rebelled; Minister Zhakedang'a was shot dead; rebels burned the Han city, took the Hui quarter, and held Boxidar prisoner.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，巴里坤總兵何琯令游擊凌祥趨救，攻拔回城，賊遁吐魯番，伯錫爾奏留凌祥為副將。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year Balikun General He Gong ordered Ranger Ling Xiang to hurry to the rescue, stormed and took the Hui city, rebels fled to Turfan, and Boxidar memorialized to retain Ling Xiang as vice general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year General He Gong of Balikun sent Ling Xiang to relieve the city; the Hui quarter was retaken and the rebels fled to Turfan; Boxidar asked to keep Ling Xiang as vice general.

sentences.zh: 旋以叛黨蔓延，奏由烏里雅蘇台將軍檄召明安郡王蒙兵，合巴里坤、哈密諸兵，共攻吐魯番。

translations.literal: Soon as rebel factions spread he memorialized that the Uliasutai general should summon Ming'an Junwang's Mongol troops, combining Balikun and Hami forces to attack Turfan together.
translations.idiomatic: As rebellion spread he asked the Uliasutai general to summon Prince Ming'an's Mongols and join Balikun and Hami troops against Turfan.

sentences.zh: 又數遣使至肅州，請提督成祿出塞，皆不果。

translations.literal: He also repeatedly sent envoys to Suzhou begging General Cheng Lu to march beyond the pass—all without result.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys again and again to Suzhou begging General Cheng Lu to march out—all in vain.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蘇布格率南北各城叛回五千人復來侵，凌祥以民勇三千、伯克夏斯勒以纏回五千人出禦，覆沒於柳樹泉，凌祥遁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Subuge led five thousand rebels from north and south cities to invade again; Ling Xiang with three thousand civilian braves and Bek Xiaisle with five thousand Chantefu went out to meet them and were destroyed at Liushuquan; Ling Xiang fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Subuge led five thousand rebels from every city; Ling Xiang with three thousand militia and Bek Xiaisle with five thousand Chantefu met them at Liushuquan and were wiped out; Ling Xiang fled.

sentences.zh: 或謂伯錫爾：「盍行乎？」

translations.literal: Some said to Boxidar: "Why not go?"
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Boxidar: "Will you not flee?"

sentences.zh: 伯錫爾歎曰：「吾世受天子恩，備籓於此，臨難何可苟免？」

translations.literal: Boxidar sighed: "My house has received the Son of Heaven's grace for generations, guarding the frontier here—how in peril can I seek to escape?"
translations.idiomatic: Boxidar sighed: "My line has received the Son of Heaven's grace for generations as guardians here—how can I flee when peril comes?"

sentences.zh: 收殘卒二千，复戰於頭堡，又大敗，被執。

translations.literal: He gathered two thousand remnant soldiers and fought again at Toubao, was again beaten greatly, and was seized.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered two thousand remnant troops, fought again at Toubao, was routed, and was taken.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，罵賊死，詔贈親王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year he cursed the rebels and died; an edict posthumously made him qinwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year he cursed the rebels and was killed; the throne posthumously made him qinwang.
